results.title: Gone Girl
results.overview: With his wife's disappearance having become the focus of an intense media circus, a man sees the spotlight turned on him when it's suspected that he may not be innocent.

results.title: Gone Girl
results.overview: Kayleigh Haywood, a teenage girl addicted to social media, meets a stranger online who lures her into a trap.

results.title: Girl Gone Bad
results.overview: When 16-year old Samantha has the house to herself over the weekend, she plans a romantic night for her and her girlfriend. However, when an intruder makes his way into her home, it's fight or flight on a night that will change her life.

results.title: Girl Gone Bad
results.overview: The documentary film GIRL GONE BAD is a wild ride into the extraordinary world of female motorcyclists, an amazing group of women few people know anything about, with hard-core biker Dusty, a native-born Apache, ex-felon, ex-go-go dancer, and a single mother of three as our guide.

results.title: Umjolo: The Gone Girl
results.overview: A couple's seemingly perfect relationship falters when one of them learns about the other's infidelity — but who said that relationships were easy?

results.title: Good Girl Gone
results.overview: A young girl having escaped from being trafficked seeks shelter, videotaping herself as a message for her drug-addicted mother with whether or not she could, or should, come back to the life she once knew.

results.title: GIRL GONE SAVED!
results.overview: A young girl conflates divine intervention with a chance sexual encounter.

results.name: Street Outlaws: Gone Girl
results.overview: Street racing is a motorsport with no barriers. If you can drive and you’re fast, then you can take home the win. The fastest female drivers from around the country are converging in Las Vegas to pull off the ultimate street hustle and speed away with as much cash as possible — not to mention some serious street cred.

results.title: Good Girl Gone Bad
results.overview: West Germany, 1983. Seventeen-year-old Ursula wants it all and is thus too much, although all she's looking for is love. Enter Siegfried Grimm, the charismatic new teacher who finally recognizes Ursula's true potential. She falls for him, head over heels. A pity that Grimm sexually liberates the entire village - except Ursula. While the Grimm acolytes fight for the favor of their idol, Ursula resorts to more radical measures. Whatever it takes, she'll get back at Grimm.

results.title: Rihanna - Good Girl Gone Bad Live
results.original_title: Rihanna - Good Girl Gone Bad Live
results.overview: The award-winning singer performs live at the MEN Arena in Manchester in December 2007. Tracks include: 'Umbrella', 'S.O.S.', 'Don't Stop the Music', 'Shut Up and Drive', and many more.

results.title: Where Have You Gone, Girl?
results.overview: Hallie Green's world is turned upside down when she is viciously attacked by a masked killer.

results.name: Girls Gone Wild Presents: Search for the Hottest Girl in America
results.original_name: Girls Gone Wild Presents: Search for the Hottest Girl in America

results.title: Wild Girls Gone
results.overview: In the Spring Break capital of White Sands, Florida, Sheriff Terry Moran outlaws the town's world famous ass contests to win the elderly vote in his campaign for Mayor - even though he is married to the town's former Ass Contest Queen, Doreen. Unhappy with how her husband is changing, Doreen breaks out of her bored drunk housewife existence to recapture her youth and to subvert her husband's campaign.

results.title: Ghost Girl Gone Global: How Sadako Terrorized Tinseltown
results.original_title: Ghost Girl Gone Global: How Sadako Terrorized Tinseltown
results.overview: A documentary made about the transition of the RING horror film franchise from Japan to America. The documentary was produced for the Shout. Factory box set comprising new 4k editions of the three American RING films.
